author: Adele Henley
title: Bay County man arrested in Louisiana after fleeing sexual battery charges - NewsBreak
text:
By Adele Henley ,
1 hours ago
BAY COUNTY, Fla. ( WMBB ) – A Bay County man was arrested in Louisiana on Wednesday after he allegedly attempted to flee the county to evade sexual battery charges.
Bay County Sheriff’s investigators say 36-year-old Jeffery Alan Howard was accused of capital sexual battery against a 4-year-old child.
On July 31, deputies received a report regarding the alleged sexual abuse. The child was interviewed at Gulf Coast Children’s Advocacy Center by BCSO’s Criminal Investigation Division for Crimes Against Children.
Following the interview, deputies determined probable cause to arrest Howard. Deputies travelled to Howard’s residence in the early morning hours on Saturday, but Howard refused to come to the door.
Deputies report obtaining an arrest warrant. However, deputies learned Howard had left the residence and fled Bay County shortly after law enforcement had left to obtain the warrant.
Using Flock cameras, deputies determined that Howard was in New Orleans, Louisiana.
On Wednesday, U.S. Marshals Task Force officers were able to take Howard into custody in Amite City, Louisiana.
Howard is currently awaiting extradition to Bay County to face a charge of capital sexual battery.
